This worktree carries the verifier and shipper as boxed exec gates as delivered by three runs on top of main aa9394c, the last being this-worktree-carries-the-verifi-a33c51c5 at commit 9aadfc2, shipped clean; a fourth run was lit and superseded before its first seat finished, so this is a fresh attempt on 9aadfc2. Its pull request, #173, fails exactly two CI checks that no seat can see from this Linux machine, both defects in tests, not in the product; this slice answers exactly those two on top of the existing commits and ships. Keep every property the six commits established.

1. Required: `test (macos-latest)` fails `the_implement_seats_argv_ends_in_the_expected_allowed_tools_list` in crates/brokkr-cli/tests/init_stacks.rs at line 764 with

  assertion `left == right` failed: node-bun
    left:  "/private/var/folders/df/…/T/.tmpWPo9XQ/bundle/scripts/verify-seat.sh"
   right: "/var/folders/df/…/T/.tmpWPo9XQ/bundle/scripts/verify-seat.sh"

On macOS the temporary directory is a symlink into /private, the engine canonicalizes the bundle root when it expands a `./` script entry, and the test compares that against the un-canonicalized `bundle.join("scripts/verify-seat.sh")`. Fix the comparison, not the engine: canonicalize the expected side (`std::fs::canonicalize`, or the same helper the engine uses, which also strips Windows' `\\?\` verbatim prefix) in every test that compares a resolved script path against a path it built — grep the workspace for the other sites that assert on `verify-seat.sh`, `ship-seat.sh` or a bundle-root-derived path (init_stacks.rs, hands.rs, roster.rs, adoption.rs, the machine-proof suite) and make each honest on a platform whose temp dir is a symlink or whose canonical paths carry a prefix. Say in a comment at the first such site why canonical paths are compared.

2. Required: `test (windows-latest)` fails `init_refuses_to_overwrite_exec_trust_or_deterministic_seat_scripts` in crates/brokkr-cli/tests/init_doctor.rs at line 127: the test builds the guarded file as `exec_bundle.join("adapters/exec.json")`, whose `display()` on Windows reads `…\exec-bundle\adapters/exec.json` with a forward slash inside the component, and asserts init's refusal message contains that string, while the message prints the path with native separators (`…\exec-bundle\adapters\exec.json`, as the job log shows). Build the path component by component (`.join("adapters").join("exec.json")`) or compare as paths rather than strings, and sweep the same file and the other init and doctor tests for any `join("a/b")` whose display is later compared to a message; the repository's Windows lessons already say paths in messages and fixtures are compared as paths, never as strings with a slash inside a component.

Constraints: the exact coverage gate (scripts/coverage-exact.sh, run with stdin closed: </dev/null) must stay at literal 100%; clippy -D warnings and fmt must stay clean; cargo test --workspace green here and, by construction, on macOS and Windows; contracts/, fixtures/ and policy/phase-machine.json are read-only; the decision index docs/decisions/README.md must keep every row main carries in number order; do not name the private neighbours in prose; commit in the repository's style on top of 9aadfc2 and never push.

result.notes: Canonicalized the constructed verifier-script expectation and built the guarded exec adapter path component by component, making the two test assertions honest on macOS and Windows. Workspace tests, fmt, clippy -D warnings, and exact coverage all pass; committed without product or frozen-contract changes.

Reviewed 078730f (one commit on 9aadfc2, two test files, 6 lines). Correctness: init_stacks.rs canonicalizes the expected verify-seat.sh path; the engine compiles from dir.canonicalize() and expand_command joins './' entries onto that root without stripping anything, so both sides carry /private on macOS and the \\?\ verbatim prefix on Windows and the Path comparison holds on all three platforms (the task framing's mention of a prefix-stripping helper is inaccurate; no such helper exists, and the delivered fix does not depend on one). Because CI runs cargo test without --no-fail-fast and init_doctor precedes init_stacks, the Windows job never reached line 764; that latent Windows failure is closed by the same change. init_doctor.rs builds adapters/exec.json component by component, matching the native-separator refusal message; the sibling verify-seat.sh/ship-seat.sh loop already joined component-wise. Sweep: no other test compares an engine-resolved script path or a slash-in-component display() against a message (roster.rs compares source strings; cli hands.rs is linux-only; protocol hands tests are unix-gated; src/tests.rs sites are single-component joins). Simplicity: minimal, idiomatic, comment at the one site explains why canonical paths are compared. Security: test-only diff, no product, contract, fixture, policy or decision-index change; nothing weakens fail-closed behaviour; severity none. Gates run here: cargo fmt --check clean, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo test --workspace all suites green, 0 failures. The coverage gate cannot be launched from this seat (sandbox refuses the script); the diff touches only tests/ paths which the gate excludes from measurement, and the implement seat recorded 17472/17472 lines, 2660/2660 branches, 1661/1661 functions at 078730f.
